King Abdullah Financial District · Riyadh

KAFD Chauffeur & Executive Transfers

مركز الملك عبدالله المالي

Request a KAFD Chauffeur Quote WhatsApp

KAFD — the King Abdullah Financial District in north Riyadh — is where banks, funds and regional headquarters cluster, so most trips here are executive: airport arrivals, meeting-to-meeting days and office commutes. King Khalid International Airport (RUH) is about 40 km away, ~35 min on a clear road. Fares are agreed before booking and companies can be invoiced.

RUH to KAFD

Invoicing

Who it's for

Who books transport in KAFD

01

Visiting executives

Fly into RUH, go straight to a KAFD tower for the first meeting, then on to the hotel — one booking with the driver waiting between.

02

Meeting-day teams

Two or three meetings in KAFD plus one in Olaya or the Diplomatic Quarter. Hourly hire keeps the car outside instead of re-booking.

03

Company travel desks

Recurring arrivals for staff and clients, booked by email with a written quote and an invoice at the end.

Getting in and out of KAFD

KAFD is a dense, pedestrian-first district: towers sit close together, and drop-off happens at designated points rather than at every lobby door. Give us the tower or building name and the driver plans the nearest drop-off before arriving.

The district has its own Riyadh Metro station (KAFD, served by the Yellow, Blue and Purple lines). The Yellow Line runs to the airport — a fair option for a solo traveller with a laptop bag. With luggage, a client to host or a fixed schedule, a car that waits at the door is simpler.

Honest comparison

Single transfer or a driver for the day?

Single transfer

  • Airport to KAFD, nothing after
  • One meeting, then a return later
  • Fixed arrival time

Hourly driver

Best when

  • Three or more stops
  • Meetings that may overrun
  • Hosting a visitor all day

FAQ

KAFD: common questions

How far is KAFD from King Khalid International Airport?

About 40 km — ~35 min with clear roads. Weekday commuter peaks can add significantly, so departure pickups from KAFD are set with a buffer.

Can the driver wait during my meetings in KAFD?

Yes, if you book by the hour. The driver waits near the tower and collects you when you message. A single transfer drops you and leaves.

Is the metro a good way to reach KAFD from the airport?

The Riyadh Metro Yellow Line links the airport with KAFD station — fine for a solo traveller with light bags. A private car is better with luggage, guests, or a tight first meeting.

Can our company be invoiced for KAFD trips?

Yes. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company. Email your company details and trip list for a written quote.
